name: ChEMBL_search_similar_molecules
description: Search for molecules similar to a given SMILES, chembl_id, or compound or drug name, using the ChEMBL Web Services. Note: This tool is designed for small molecule compounds only. Biologics (antibodies, proteins, oligonucleotides, etc.) do not have SMILES structures and cannot be used for similarity search. For biologics similarity search, use BLAST_protein_search (requires amino acid sequence) or UniProt_search. For small molecules, use PubChem_search_compounds_by_similarity (requires SMILES input).

query.description: SMILES string, chembl_id, or compound or drug name. Note: Only small molecule compounds are supported. Biologics (antibodies, proteins, etc.) will return an error as they lack SMILES structures.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

oneOf.description: The failure envelope the tool returns instead of a result, e.g. when the optional epam.indigo dependency for structure similarity is absent.

name: ChEMBL_get_molecule
description: Get detailed information about a molecule by its ChEMBL ID. Returns molecule properties, structures, synonyms, and related data.

molecule_chembl_id.description: Alias for chembl_id. ChEMBL molecule ID, e.g., CHEMBL1229517.

status.description: Request status

data.description: Molecule data including structures, properties, synonyms

url.description: The exact ChEMBL URL that produced this reply, filters and page size included. The record of what was actually asked, which the arguments alone do not pin down once defaults are applied.

page_meta.description: ChEMBL's own pagination block, copied through when ChEMBL sends one. 'total_count' is how many records MATCH; the list in data is only the page that came back, so these two numbers disagree whenever the answer is truncated and nothing else in the reply says so.

offset.description: How many matching records were skipped before this page.

total_count.description: How many records match the query in total. Compare with 'count' to tell a complete answer from a first page.

next.description: Path of the next page, or null on the last one.

previous.description: Path of the previous page, or null on the first one.

pagination.description: ChEMBL's alternative pagination block, copied through for the endpoints that send 'page' instead of 'page_meta'. Only one of the two is ever present.

error.description: Why the call failed, e.g. 'ChEMBL API returned HTTP 500'. Present only on a failure, where 'status' reads 'error' and 'data' is absent.

status_code.description: The HTTP status ChEMBL returned on a failed call, e.g. 500 or 404. Separates a malformed query from an upstream outage, which the error text alone does not.

detail.description: The first 500 characters of ChEMBL's response body on a failure. Often an HTML error page rather than JSON, so it is for diagnosis, not parsing.

name: ChEMBL_search_molecules
description: Search molecules by name, ChEMBL ID, or other criteria. Supports filtering and pagination. Note: some text-based filters (especially `pref_name__contains`) may legitimately return zero results because `pref_name` coverage is incomplete and may not contain common drug names. For reliable retrieval, prefer ID-based filters like `molecule_chembl_id` or use `ChEMBL_get_molecule` when you already have a ChEMBL ID.

pref_name__contains.description: Filter by preferred name (contains). Note: `pref_name` coverage is incomplete in ChEMBL, so this can legitimately return zero results even for common names; prefer `molecule_chembl_id` for reliable retrieval.

query.description: Molecule name to search for. Alias for pref_name__contains.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Alias for limit.

fields.description: Optional list of ChEMBL molecule fields to include in each returned molecule object (projection). ToolUniverse maps this to ChEMBL's `only` query parameter (comma-separated). Supported fields: molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, molecule_type, max_phase, first_approval, black_box_warning, withdrawn_flag, molecule_structures, molecule_properties.

status.description: 'success' or 'error'. The only field present on both the success and the failure shape, so it is what should be checked first.

action_type.description: What the drug does to the target, e.g. 'INHIBITOR', 'AGONIST', 'ANTAGONIST', 'BLOCKER'. The direction of the effect; mechanism_of_action gives the prose, this gives the machine-readable verb. Null where ChEMBL records none.

direct_interaction.description: 1 when the drug acts on the target directly, 0 when the effect is indirect. Read as a direct interaction when it is not, a mechanism row overstates the pharmacology.

molecular_mechanism.description: 1 when the mechanism is established at the molecular level rather than inferred.

disease_efficacy.description: 1 when the target is believed to mediate the drug's efficacy in the approved indication, 0 when the interaction is real but not the therapeutic one.

max_phase.description: The furthest clinical phase the drug has reached, e.g. 4 for approved. Says whether a mechanism belongs to a marketed drug or to one abandoned in phase 1.

binding_site_comment.description: Free-text note on where the drug binds, where one is recorded.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL id of the drug the row is about, e.g. 'CHEMBL1201581'.

name: ChEMBL_search_documents
description: Search ChEMBL documents (publications) by various criteria.

document_chembl_id.description: Filter by document ChEMBL ID (e.g. 'CHEMBL1158643'). This is the identifier /document indexes on; the internal numeric document_id is not a filter ChEMBL accepts.

status.description: 'success' or 'error'. The only field present on both the success and the failure shape, so it is what should be checked first.

page_meta.description: ChEMBL's pagination block as it arrives inside the payload. total_count.description: How many records match the query in total.

next.description: Path of the next page, or null on the last one.

previous.description: Path of the previous page, or null on the first one.
